subject: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term options and EU VAT split
messages:
From: Chris Torres <chris.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term & EU billing

Hi Evelyn,

We're coming up on our renewal for the Redwood capacity on the AWS Marketplace later this quarter. Two quick asks from procurement and finance:

1) We want to annualize the agreement (move from 12 monthly commitments to a single annual commitment) and discuss pricing impact.
2) For EU operations, we need VAT invoicing to go to Acme Health EU (VAT ID: EU123456789) rather than the US entity. Can the private offer be structured to split billing by billing entity (EU vs US) so our tax team can reconcile?

Attached is our current PO for reference (we'll send the signed version from procurement once terms are agreed). Also planning a 1.5x capacity uplift across LLM inference during the renewal if we can lock a predictable unit price.

Appreciate any guidance on the Marketplace workflow and whether Redwood can coordinate the private offer + DocuSign flow with AWS.

Thanks,
Chris
Chris Torres
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Torres <chris.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term & EU billing

Chris —

Thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front: yes, we can annualize and yes, we can structure the private offer to account for the EU billing entity (VAT-inclusive invoices) + US billing. There are a few operational steps we typically follow for AWS Marketplace private offers and a couple of finance questions we'll need to confirm.

Requested next steps from Redwood:
- Can you share the legal entity names and VAT IDs for the EU billing entity?
- Is Acme procurement asking for Net45 on invoices? If so, we'll surface that to finance early.
- Confirm the target start date for the annual term if you have one.

I'll loop in our Marketplace and finance ops internally (Dev, Naomi) to draft the private offer layout and confirm the DocuSign/PO flow. If you can share the PO PDF, that helps.

I'll propose an internal plan and timeline by Monday.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts — Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: procurement@acmehealth.com
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term & EU billing

Evelyn,

Attached is the PO draft (acme_po_draft_v2.pdf). Notes from procurement:
- We prefer Net45 payment terms.
- We'd like the commitment to be annualized for budget forecasting.
- Target renewal (term start): 2027-11-01.
- Capacity request: 1.5x uplift from current committed units (see PO line 3).

We can have a signed PO ready in DocuSign once pricing and the marketplace handle are confirmed. Please include the EU VAT ID on the invoice lines for EU billed amounts:
Acme Health EU BV — VAT ID: EU123456789

Thanks,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_po_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term & EU billing

Team — forwarding Acme's PO and ask. Key negotiation points:
- They want Net45 (finance will flag cashflow impact).
- EU VAT must be billed to Acme Health EU; we need to confirm which billing flow on the Marketplace supports split invoicing (often requires separate subscription lines tied to different billing entities).
- They're asking for a 1.5x capacity uplift and annualization starting 2027-11-01.

Proposed approach (initial):
1) Create a two-line private offer in AWS Marketplace: Line A (EU entity, VAT-inclusive pricing) and Line B (US entity, net pricing). This lets procurement reconcile EU VAT without manual apportionment.
2) Offer an annualized discount: 10% off list for a 12-month commit (we can present a tiered discount: 5% at 1.2x, 10% at 1.5x+).
3) Accept Net45 pending finance approval; if finance objects, negotiate an early-pay discount or a small surcharge for extended terms.
4) Redwood to prepare the private-offer-summary.xlsx and an initial DocuSign packet for signature routing to procurement@acmehealth.com. We'll copy AWS Marketplace on the private offer creation so their billing team can validate VAT routing.

Questions for Marcus/Dev/Naomi: can you confirm if AWS Marketplace supports two billing entities under a single private offer for the same customer account, or do we need to create two separate private offers? Also, what lead time do we need to ensure the private offer is published and visible to Acme by 2027-10-20 (so procurement can sign before 11/1)?

I've attached a quick summary workbook to use in the customer call.

— Evelyn

Attachment: private-offer-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Torres <chris.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace <mp-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: Marketplace private offer — term & EU billing

Chris / Acme team —

Thanks for the PO and clarity on timing. Quick summary and proposed next steps so we're all aligned:

Summary:
- Redwood will draft an AWS Marketplace private offer with two billing lines (EU billing entity with VAT-inclusive invoices; US billing entity net invoices).
- Proposed term start: 2027-11-01 for a 12-month annualized commitment.
- Capacity uplift: 1.5x across committed units (line item in the private offer).
- Pricing: proposed 10% annualization discount at 1.5x uplift; alternate tiered structure available.
- Payment terms: Net45 requested; we'll route to finance for approval and confirm any early-pay incentive.

Next steps / timeline:
1) Redwood to create the private offer draft and publish a pre-signed view for review by 2027-09-21. (Redwood ops + AWS Marketplace to coordinate.)
2) Acme to review pricing and confirm acceptance by 2027-09-28.
3) Finalized DocuSign packet sent to procurement@acmehealth.com by 2027-10-04.
4) Receive signed PO and DocuSign confirmation by 2027-10-20 to allow AWS Marketplace processing before the 11/1 term start.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7421
- DocuSign invite (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/participant/invite?env=prod&txn=ABC123
- Attachments: acme_po_draft_v2.pdf; private-offer-summary.xlsx; docusign-invite.pdf

I'll coordinate with AWS Marketplace (mp-sales@amazon.com) to confirm whether a single private offer can route invoices to two legal entities; if not, we'll create two aligned private offers and present consolidated billing mapping in the DocuSign packet.

Would you like a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to walk through the private offer layout?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts — Marketplace
Redwood Inference
